description: The request requires joining order value to customer email, which is PII-classified. The actor's access policy does not grant PII read for the customer_email column. The route MUST block before any data access, state the minimum authorization required, and MUST NOT return PII values or sample values (SEC-001, SEC-002). The LLM may draft metric documentation but cannot auto-approve a PII-bearing canonical definition (SEM-003).

expected_findings.reason: The actor 'analyst_acme_example' lacks PII read access for the customer_email column required by this request; the route must not attempt privilege escalation or bypass.
expected_findings.recovery: Grant the actor PII read access for customer_email (or a pseudonymized derivative) via the governed access policy before retrying.

expected_findings.reason: The disclosure policy for restricted PII columns requires SQL-only return for authorized operators; no result or sample value may be returned to this actor.
expected_findings.recovery: Either authorize the actor for PII disclosure and return SQL only, or restate the question to avoid PII columns.

expected_findings.reason: A PII-bearing canonical metric definition cannot be auto-created or auto-approved by the LLM; the metric owner must confirm it.
expected_findings.recovery: Request the metric owner to define and approve the customer_order_value_by_email metric before it is used.
